thermostat_contact_lost_wireless.title: {room_name}: no contact with the thermostat
thermostat_contact_lost_wireless.description:
The Uponor controller has stopped hearing from the thermostat in {room_name}. The controller only reports this after about an hour without a reading, so the thermostat stopped before this notice appeared.

Until it reports again:
- its readings are unavailable in Home Assistant, because the gateway only repeats the last values it received
- the controller is not regulating the room to its setpoint, but runs it on a fixed fallback cycle regardless of the room temperature

The thermostat can look normal: its display may keep showing the last reading after the thermostat has stopped. Replace its batteries, or take them out and put them back to restart it. If it still does not reconnect, check that it is within range of the controller.

This notice clears by itself when the thermostat reports again.

thermostat_contact_lost_wired.title: {room_name}: no contact with the thermostat
thermostat_contact_lost_wired.description:
The Uponor controller has stopped hearing from the thermostat in {room_name}.

Until it reports again:
- its readings are unavailable in Home Assistant, because the gateway only repeats the last values it received
- the controller is not regulating the room to its setpoint, and may run it on a fixed fallback cycle instead

Check the thermostat's cable to the controller and the connection at both ends.

This notice clears by itself when the thermostat reports again.

thermostat_contact_lost.title: {room_name}: no contact with the thermostat
thermostat_contact_lost.description:
The Uponor controller has stopped hearing from the thermostat in {room_name}.

Until it reports again:
- its readings are unavailable in Home Assistant, because the gateway only repeats the last values it received
- the controller is not regulating the room to its setpoint, and may run it on a fixed fallback cycle instead

Check that the thermostat has power and can reach the controller. A thermostat can stop working without its display showing it.

This notice clears by itself when the thermostat reports again.

dump_hardware_info.name: Dump Hardware Info
dump_hardware_info.description: Returns raw hardware IDs and capability flags for every thermostat and controller. The response is shown directly in Developer Tools → Services. Useful for identifying unknown device models.

dump_raw_data.name: Dump Raw Data
dump_raw_data.description: Returns the complete raw data dictionary received from the gateway. Useful for inspecting all available variables and their current values.
